//: Strict, and checked by `pnpm typecheck` — which is a real gate rather than an
aspiration: a spec that does not compile is a spec that cannot run, and a suite whose
type errors are tolerated is one step from a suite whose assertions are.
`noEmit` because Playwright transpiles the specs itself; nothing here is built.
The compiler is used as a linter, and that is its whole job in this package.
//allowImportingTsExtensions: Documented up here and not beside the option, because `compilerOptions` rejects an
unknown key and a `//` inside it fails the typecheck with TS5025 — measured.
The specs import `../fixtures/accounts.mts` WITH its extension, and that is the real
runtime path rather than a compiler convenience: Playwright transpiles the spec and
Node runs the fixture server under --experimental-strip-types, and both resolve the
file by the name written here. TypeScript permits the option only alongside `noEmit`,
which this package already sets because nothing here is built.
//include: `fixtures/` is in the list because it was not, and a fixture nothing typechecks is the
one place in this package where a type error survives to run time: the server is
started by Playwright as a subprocess, so its failure would arrive as a webServer that
never answered rather than as a compiler error.
